BiblicalUsage: Berodach-Baladan means "worshipper of Baal." He was king of Babylon in the days of Hezekiah. You will find it in 2 Kings 20:12.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Berodach-Baladan is worth remembering, even when little else is told — God counts His people one by one.
